scheduled_maintenances.name: Announcing IP Address Changes (No Operational Impact)

incident_updates.body:
The following new IPv4 subnet ranges will be deployed to Zoom resources for the Zoom Contact Center (ZCC) Flow Script and HTTP Call widgets, as well as the Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) Flow Script widget endpoints, starting no earlier than 30 days from the posting of this notice. We recommend that network administrators, with Zoom-specific firewall or network rules, update their systems as soon as possible in preparation.

In addition to the changes above, additional addresses for the Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) HTTP call widget, AI expert assist, and knowledge base to sync content endpoints have been deployed and are in use. We recommend that network administrators, with Zoom-specific firewall or network rules, update their systems as soon as possible.

Removed IPv4 addresses for the ZCC Flow Script widget and HTTP Call widget endpoints:
79.72.1.202
80.225.76.19
84.8.104.187
84.8.110.17

New IPv4 addresses for the ZCC Flow Script widget and HTTP Call widget endpoints:
145.241.111.23
158.101.246.120

Removed IPv4 addresses for the ZVA Flow Script widget endpoints:
79.72.1.202
80.225.76.19
84.8.104.187
84.8.110.17

New IPv4 addresses for the ZVA Flow Script widget endpoints:
84.8.109.27
130.110.100.148

New IPv4 addresses for the  ZVA HTTP call widget, AI expert assist, and knowledge base to sync content endpoints:
3.66.90.228
13.37.194.4
144.24.221.20
145.241.105.147

A complete list of network firewall IP ranges and domains for Zoom can be found on the Zoom Support site at: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0060548

scheduled_maintenances.name: Scheduled Zoom Software Quarterly Lifecycle Update (11/7/2026)

incident_updates.body:
Zoom will be enforcing a new minimum version for the following areas, approximately 90 days from now, on November 7, 2026:

VDI plugin

Zoom Phone Local Survivability (ZPLS) module

Meeting SDK (Web)

All other clients and plugins not listed here will maintain the same version requirements as the August 2026 enforcement.

For more information, such as specific versions we are enforcing, refer to the Zoom Software Quarterly Lifecycle Policy support article: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0061130

To assist with checking the client versions on your account, refer to the Dashboard support article:
https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0062208#h_13ce9a73-91e5-4df6-9cb5-c815b1605cf5
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance to upgrade our Push Notification Service.

No operational impact is expected. This maintenance includes the following enhancements and improvements:

* Ratelimit enhancement

* Fixed presence related bugs

All services are expected to operate normally during the maintenance window.
